items.a: G12 (zero API, D1 APPROVED) is a prospective, label-blind scaffold amendment: the agent now sees its own requests, a call counter, a named rejection, and a truncation flag. Calibration-3c (same 3 tasks, not scored) is CLEAN: gate v3 CG-1..CG-12 PASS, 1/18 rejected repeats (5.6% vs 52.4%), longest run 1, 4 reads, 0 instrument errors, $0.063205.
items.ar: G12 أصلح الحلقة اللي الـharness كان بيعملها. Calibration-3c نظيفة تمامًا: التكرار نزل من 11/21 إلى 1/18، وكل بوابات v3 عدت.

items.a: The loop was created by the harness: the transcript showed results but not the agent's own requests, and a rejection added only 18 tokens, so at temperature 0 the model repeated itself. Fixing it restores withheld information, is label-blind, strengthens the competitor (conservative for our claim), and is one preregistered amendment (D5).
items.ar: إصلاح الحلقة مش tuning: بيعيد معلومات الـharness كان شايلها، بدون labels، وبيرجّح المنافس قبل المقارنة — اتجاه محافظ ومسجل مرة واحدة.
